The '''Lazerian Orbital Command''' was an agency responsible for tracking all inbound and outbound [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to [[Lazerian IV]]. The [[Lazerian space fleet]] was also under the command of the LOC.<ref name="Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
